Obverse Chiang Kai-shek left · the photo reads 中華民國九十七年 (Republic of China Year 97 = 2008; the pen label and the old ledger said 67 = 1978, corrected 2026-10-06 from the photo). Reverse 壹圓 · 1. C200.story: A 2008 1 yuan from Taiwan (Republic of China). The obverse shows Chiang Kai-shek facing left, with 中華民國九十七年 (Republic of China year 97, which is 2008); the reverse shows 壹圓 and 1. Struck in aluminium-bronze.
